question: Which of the following countries has more than one standard meridian?
solution:
The correct answer is __**USA **__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **United States of America (USA) has more than one standard meridian**
 
• The **USA has seven time zones, and the lower 48 states** are covered by f**our zones based on the 75°, 90°, 105°, and 120**° central meridians. 
 
• This **is because it would be inconvenient to have a single time zone in these large countries. **
 
• The** prime meridian is a line of longitude that defines 0° and divides the Earth into the Eastern and Western Hemispheres**
 
• The** prime meridian is the reference line for Greenwich Mean Time (GMT)** and represents the center of world time

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Countries with multiple standard meridians**
 
• Countries** with a large east-to-west span may choose more than one standard meridian to create more than one time zon**e.
 
 
• Other countries with multiple standard meridians include Russia, Canada, Australia, Mexico, Brazil, Indonesia, Kazakhstan, Mongolia, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Kiribati, Micronesia, Chile, Spain, Portugal, and Ecuador.
